mapper.delete: DELETE FROM `follow` WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `follow` WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.role, f.create_time AS follow_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `follow` f3 WHERE f3.followee_id = u.id) AS follower_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `follow` f2 WHERE f2.follower_id = u.id AND f2.followee_id = #{userId}) AS mutual FROM `follow` f JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.followee_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
